name: Website to AI Company Summary (free, Gemini free tier)

parameters.content:
## Website -> AI Company Summary
Paste a company URL, get a clean research card: name, one-line pitch, summary, industry, B2B/B2C, target customers, tech stack, LinkedIn, public emails and 3 personalisation hooks for outreach.

Runs on **free** tools only: plain HTTP fetch + Google Gemini free tier (or Groq / a local Ollama model via any OpenAI-compatible URL).

### Setup (3 min)
1. Get a free API key at aistudio.google.com.
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_KEY`. Select it in **AI Company Summary**.
3. Change `website_url` in **Set Website** and click **Execute workflow**.

Other providers: set `llm_base_url` to `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama) and change `llm_model`.

### Notes
- JS-only sites return little text; try their `/about` page.
- Website text is treated as untrusted (prompt-injection guard).
- Free tier limits apply - add a Wait node when looping many URLs.
